description: Drafts: a private copy of an app (id "_<appId>") to change files and settings without touching the live app. "info" says whether one exists; "create" makes it (edit it by passing its id to the file/app tools); "apply" promotes the draft over the live app (replaces its files and settings — confirm first; a rooms change that loses data needs confirmRoomsChange); "discard" deletes the draft.

confirmRoomsChange.description: For "apply": accept a rooms change that discards saved rooms data

name: neblla_draft
